name: net.haselab.netsim
displayName: NetSim - Multi-client Network Simulator for VRChat Worlds
description: Editor-only simulator that runs multiple ClientSim clients in Unity Editor and routes Udon networking (network events, synced variables, ownership, late join, master leave, object sync) through a simulated server with latency, jitter and loss.

samples.description: A small world with correct sync patterns, planted sync bugs and a scenario that checks NetSim finds them.
Example scenarios and test bots for NetSim.
